name: bunprise
description: Bunprise (code name wishcal) monorepo: PWA (apps/web), mascots (packages/mascot), DB/RLS tests (packages/db-tests), Cloudflare Worker (workers/edge).

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:concurrency && npm run build && npm run size
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c workers/edge/wrangler.jsonc
